summary: Completed Module 01 BREAK: Diagnosed intermittent pagination drift under concurrent writes
evidence: Identified race condition: Concurrent inserts push newly created records to the front of the dataset, shifting existing record index offsets downwards
Explained root cause of intermittent duplicate reads: Offset-based pagination relies on static snapshot assumptions, causing the last record of Page 1 to slide to the first index of Page 2
Formulated mitigation requirements: Deterministic ORDER BY with unique primary key tie-breaker (Link.id) and cursor-based / keyset pagination to anchor window boundaries
